back_translation: The word that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

In the last days, the mountain of the House of the LORD will be established as the highest peak of the mountains; it will be lifted above all the hills, and all the nations will stream to that mountain.

Many peoples will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the House of the God of Jacob, so that He may teach us His ways and so that we may walk in His paths." For the law will go out from Zion, and the word of the LORD will go out from Jerusalem.

He will judge between the nations and will decide cases for many peoples. They will hammer their swords into plow-blades and their spears into pruning knives. Nation will not lift up the sword against nation, and they will not learn war anymore.
O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the LORD.

For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are full of things from the east; they are omen-interpreters like the Philistines, and they clasp hands in league with the children of foreigners.
Their land is full of silver and gold; their treasures have no end. Their land is full of horses; their war-chariots also have no end.
Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their own hands, bowing to what their fingers have made.
So mankind is pressed down low, and the people are made to fall low — please do not forgive them!
Crawl into the rock crevice and hide yourself in the dust, away from the dreadfulness of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty.
The haughty eyes of man will be made to fall low, and the arrogance of the people will be pressed down low, and the LORD alone will be held in exaltation in that day.
For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come over everything proud and arrogant, over everything lifted up high — and it will be made to fall low.
Over all the cedars of Lebanon, towering and lifted up, and over all the oaks of Bashan,
over all the towering mountains, and over all the hills that are lifted up,
over every high tower, and over every fortress wall,
over every ship of Tarshish, and over every magnificently beautiful vessel.
The haughtiness of man will be pressed down low, and the arrogance of the people will be made to fall low, and the LORD alone will be held in exaltation in that day.
And all the idols will perish away completely.
People will go into rock caves and into holes in the ground, away from the dreadfulness of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises up to make the earth tremble.
In that day, mankind will fling their idols of silver and idols of gold, which they made to bow and worship, throwing them away to the moles and the bats.

To crawl into the clefts of the rock-crags and into the fissures of the cliffs, away from the dreadfulness of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises up to make the earth tremble.
Stop trusting in man, who has only breath in his nostrils, for of what worth is he?
